name: vibeaudit
description: Audits AI-generated (vibecoded) apps for security, quality, performance, and compliance gaps — before they reach production.

interface.shortDescription: Security and quality auditing for AI-generated (vibecoded) apps.
interface.longDescription: vibeAudit provides focused audit skills for security (OWASP Top 10, injection, secrets, crypto), quality (AI slop, error handling, dead code), and performance (N+1 queries, bundle size, re-renders). Skills load conditionally based on detected stack: Next.js, Supabase, Stripe, React Native, Node API, LLM integrations, Vercel. All findings are severity-classified: Critical, High, Medium, Low, Info.
defaultPrompt: Run a security audit on this codebase.
Find AI-generated slop and security risks in these changes.
Audit this vibecoded app before it goes to production.
